name: opencode-semantic-lsp
description: Symbol finder algorithm for code navigation

scripts.build: tsc && esbuild src/opencode-tool.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/symbol-finder.js --format=esm --platform=node --external:fs --external:path && esbuild src/semantic-lsp-plugin.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/semantic-lsp-plugin.js --format=esm --platform=node --external:fs --external:path && rm -rf dist/skills && cp -r src/skills dist/skills
scripts.pack:build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:plugin
scripts.pack:dir: npm run pack:build && mkdir -p .pack-tmp && npm pack --pack-destination=.pack-tmp && tar -xzf .pack-tmp/*.tgz -C .pack-tmp && rm -rf pkg/opencode-semantic-lsp && mkdir -p pkg && mv .pack-tmp/package pkg/opencode-semantic-lsp && rm -rf .pack-tmp

author: maxvst <max.v@mail.ru>
